mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Owner reports King main thrust bearings from 2024 and 2025 production slipping into the block and cap far too easily due to out-of-spec free spread; he says King's own tech line confirmed the 2024 part was out of spec and advised returning it. Several members chimed in; the OP ended up sourcing NOS Clevite bearings that measured in spec. Thread read directly today: open, unlocked, no King reply posted, newest post 3 June 2026.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.
